content.short: DragonSwap is a high-performance DEX on Sei V2 featuring concentrated liquidity and optimized trade execution.
content.description: DragonSwap is a leading decentralized exchange built on Sei V2, the first parallelized EVM blockchain, designed to offer ultra-fast trade execution and deep liquidity. The platform utilizes a concentrated liquidity model that allows liquidity providers to allocate their capital within specific price ranges, significantly improving capital efficiency and reducing slippage for traders. Powered by the DRG token, DragonSwap integrates advanced features like limit orders and optimized routing to provide a professional-grade trading experience on-chain. As a core component of the Sei ecosystem, DragonSwap leverages the network's sub-second finality and high throughput to deliver a seamless and scalable DeFi solution for modern traders.
